paite: Ahaz in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk vai ahawm; apu David bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih kei hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Ahaz / (2 Kum 16.1-4)
english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, like David his father,

paite: Israel kumpipate lampi azui zaw a, Baalte a ding in milim suntawmte abawl lai hi.
english: but he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molten images for the Baals.

paite: Hinnom tapa phaizang ah gimlimte ahal a, TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a delhkhiaksa namte thilkihhuaitak ahih sek bang un atate uh mei ah alutsak uhi.
english: Moreover he burned incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burned his children in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

paite: Mun sangte, mualte, sing hing nuaite ah akithoih a, gimlimte ahal zel hi.
english: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA a Pathian in Siria kumpipa khut ah apia a; asual ua, mi tampi sal in api ua, Damaskas ah apaipih uhi. Israel kumpipa khut a piak ahi lai a, ama'n tampi athat hi.
heading: Siria Leh Israel Toh Kidouna / (2 Kum 16.5)
english: Therefore Yahweh his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. They struck him, and carried away from him a great multitude of captives, and brought them to Damascus. He was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.

paite: Api-le-pute uh TOUPA Pathian alehngatsan ziak un. Remaliah tapa Pekah in Judah gam ah nuaikhat-le-singnih ni khat in athat a, avek un mihangsan chiat ahi uhi.
english: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed in Judah one hundred twenty thousand in one day, all of them valiant men, because they had forsaken Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

paite: Ephraim mihat Jikri in kumpipa tapa Maaseiah leh insung upa Azrikam leh Elkanah, kumpipa zom athat hi.
english: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante'n a-unaute uh nuainih, numeite, atapate uh, atanute uh sal in api ua; gallak tamtak alaksak lai ua, gallak pen Samaria ah atun uhi.
english: The children of Israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand women, sons, and daughters, and also took away much plunder from them, and brought the plunder to Samaria.

paite: Huai ah TOUPA zawlnei ana om a, amin Obed ahi; Samaria a hong pai ding sepaihte ana vaidawn a, akiang uah, "Ngai dih uh, TOUPA na pi-le-pute uh Pathian Judahte tung ah aheh a, na khut ua hon pia ei ve, heh a na thahna un van asuntou hi.
heading: Zawlnei Obed
english: But a prophet of Yahweh was there, whose name was Oded; and he went out to meet the army that came to Samaria, and said to them, “Behold, because Yahweh, the God of your fathers, was angry with Judah, he has delivered them into your hand, and you have slain them in a rage which has reached up to heaven.

paite: Judah leh Jerusalem mite sikhanu leh sikhapa in bawl na tum ua, himahleh noute ngei in leng TOUPA na Pathian uh tung ah na hihkhial uh ahi kei maw?
english: Now you intend to degrade the children of Judah and Jerusalem as male and female slaves for yourselves. Aren’t there even with you trespasses of your own against Yahweh your God?

paite: Huaiziak in ka thu pom unla, na unaute uh sal a na matte uh paisak nawn un; TOUPA hehna thupitak na tung uah a-om hi," achi hi.
english: Now hear me therefore, and send back the captives that you have taken captive from your brothers, for the fierce wrath of Yahweh is on you.”

paite: Huchi in Ephraimte heutu khenkhat, Johanan tapa Azariahte, Mesillemoth tapa Berekiahte, Shallum tapa Jehizkiah, Hadlai tapa Amasa kidouna a kipan a hong paite ana dal ua, akiang uah,
english: Then some of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against those who came from the war,

paite: "Salte na hon pilut ding uh ahi kei; ka khelhna uh leh ka tatlekna uh behlap in, TOUPA tung ah tatlekna na hon tungsak ding uh ahi, ka khelhna uh athupi mahmah ngal a, Israel mite tung ah hehna thupitak a-om hi," ana chi uhi.
english: and said to them, “You must not bring in the captives here, for you intend that which will bring on us a trespass against Yahweh, to add to our sins and to our guilt; for our guilt is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.”

paite: Huchi in sepaihte'n miliante leh mipi ma ah salte leh gallak sumte anusia uh.
english: So the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the princes and all the assembly.

paite: Huan minlohlouhte ahong thou ua, salte api ua, gallak thil in vuaktang a om teng puansilh aguan ua, avan ua, khedapte abunsak ua, nek ding leh dawn ding apia ua, sathau anilh ua, ahatloute tengteng sabiltung ah atuangsak ua, tum sing khua, Jeriko ah a-unaute uh kiang ah apaisak ua, amau Samaria ah akik nawnta uhi.
english: The men who have been mentioned by name rose up and took the captives, and with the plunder clothed all who were naked among them, dressed them, gave them sandals, gave them something to eat and to drink, anointed them, carried all the feeble of them on donkeys, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brothers. Then they returned to Samaria.

paite: Huai lai in kumpipa Ahaz in Assuria kumpipate panpihna ngen ding in mi asawl hi.
heading: Ahaz In Assuria Panpihna Angen / (2 Kum 16.7-9)
english: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.

paite: Edomte'n Judahte va sual a, sal dia hon mat thuk ziak un.
english: For again the Edomites had come and struck Judah, and carried away captives.

paite: Philistiate'n leng phailam khuate leh Judah simte ahong la ua, Beth-shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Sokoh leh akhotate toh, huan, Timnah leh akhotate, Gimzo leng akhotate toh ala ua, huai ah a-om uhi.
english: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland and of the South of Judah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and also Gimzo and its villages; and they lived there.

paite: Israel kumpipa Ahaz ziak in TOUPA'N Judahte avuallelsak hi. Judahte tung ah thanghuaitak in thil ahih a, TOUPA tung ah nakpitak in akhial ahi.
english: For Yahweh brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, because he acted without restraint in Judah and trespassed severely against Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in Siria kumpipa Tilgath-pilneser akiang ah ahong pai a, hihhat nak sang in ahihmangbang zaw hi.
english: Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came to him and gave him trouble, but didn’t strengthen him.

paite: Ahaz in TOUPA' inn, kumpipa' inn leh miliante a pan thilte ala a, Siria kumpipa apia a; himahleh aphatuam tuan kei.
english: For Ahaz took away a portion out of Yahweh’s house, and out of the house of the king and of the princes, and gave it to the king of Assyria; but it didn’t help him.

paite: Amangbat laitak in leng hiai kumpipa Ahaz in TOUPA tung ah thil ahihkhial semsem mawk hi.
heading: Ahaz Khelhnate
english: In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against Yahweh, this same King Ahaz.

paite: Amah sualmi Damaskaste pathian kiang ah akithoih hi, “Siria kumpipate' pathian in amaute apanpih ziak in kei leng ahon panpih theihna ding in akiang ah ka kithoih ding ahi," achi hi. Himahleh amah leh Israel mi tengteng siatna ahi ngal a.
english: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus which had defeated him. He said, “Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, I will sacrifice to them, that they may help me.” But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.

paite: Huchi in Ahaz in Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan akaikhawm vek a, Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan ahihkham vek a, TOUPA' inn kongkhakte akhak bikbek a; Jerusalem ning chih ah maitam abawl hi.
english: Ahaz gathered together the vessels of God’s house, cut the vessels of God’s house in pieces, and shut up the doors of Yahweh’s house; and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

paite: Judah kho tampi ah pathian dangte dia gimlim halna mun sangte abawl a, TOUPA api-le-pute Pathian ahehsak hi.
english: In every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked Yahweh, the God of his fathers, to anger.

paite: Athilhih dangte tengteng leh a-omdan tengteng abul a kipan atawp pha in ngai dih, Judate leh Israel kumpite tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om hi.
english: Now the rest of his acts, and all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

paite: Api-le-pute kiang ah Ahaz a-ihmu a, Jerusalem khopi ah avui ua; Israel kumpipate han ah akoih kei uh. Huchi in asik in atapa Hezekiah in vai ahawmta hi.
english: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem, because they didn’t bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
